newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African wool prices rise at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: S.African wool prices rise at latest auction.

text.p: South African wool prices were higher at the latest weekly auction, the Wool Board said.
It said 12,256 bales were offered at this week's sale, of which 98.3 percent was sold.

Price quotes for long Merino fleeces of 20 micron rose 4.0 percent, 21 micron rose 3.3 percent, 22 micron rose 3.1 percent, 23 micron rose 2.2 percent, 24 micron rose 2.1 percent and 25 micron rose 2.0 percent.
Prices for Merino bellies rose 0.6 percent, Merino lambs rose 2.8 percent and Merino locks fell 1.0 percent.
The offering included 1,725 bales of other White Wools, 1,374 bales of Ciskei/Transkei, 1,974 bales of Lesotho and 1,111 bales of coarse and coloured.

Of the 713 bales of 20 micron offered, 98.5 percent was sold. Of the 1,562 bales of 21 micron offered, 99.8 percent was sold. Of 2,222 bales of 22 micron offered, 99.6 percent was sold, Of 667 bales of 24 micron offered, 97.0 percent was sold. All 23 and 25 micron bales on offer were sold.
The next sale will take place on January 8, when 10,000 bales will be on offer.
